messages:
Alice M: Heads-up — we started seeing traces with missing spans for requests hitting /generate in us-west. Example trace 0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c: root span present but inference-worker child spans missing. Suspect OTLP exporter or context propagation issues. @Raj P @Diego L :eyes:

Raj P: I can reproduce in the console. Root shows ~200ms but no downstream spans (cache/model). Collector logs around 2026-03-18T14:07:12Z show 'invalid traceparent header: missing parent-id'.

Diego L: Which otel SDK + exporter on the inference-worker? Also any recent proxy/envoy changes?

Alice M: inference-worker: otel-go v0.64.0, exporter: otlphttp -> internal-collector. Sample from worker logs: ```http
POST /v1/traces
trace_id: 0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c; spans: [{name: "infer", parent_id: null}]
```
Looks like parent_id not set for child spans.

Nadia V: quick thought — we rolled an envoy header mask last night that might strip non-whitelisted headers. If traceparent/tracestate got stripped before gRPC -> collector, propagation would break. Check commit 8c9b in envoy-config.

sre-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T03:45:21 - envoy-proxy/us-west rolled.

Raj P: tailing envoy logs now, grepping for 'traceparent' and 'tracestate'. If header is absent at the proxy edge that's our culprit.

Diego L: also check collector/otlp receiver errors. If exporter is unhappy (500s) some spans might be dropped and we only see upstream root. Collector pipeline config for reference: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {send_batch_size: 512}
exporters:
  logging: {}
  otlp/jaeger: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/jaeger]
```

Alice M: collector logs show repeated 'failed to unmarshal traceparent' from 14:07:10Z -> 14:09:00Z and downstream otlp/jaeger exporter returned 500s. Could be malformed traceparent or header removal mid-path.

Raj P: confirmed — envoy config had header_mask configured to only forward `x-*` and common hop headers. traceparent/tracestate not in the allowlist. Opening PR to add explicit allow for traceparent/tracestate.

Nadia V: for mitigation, can we have the SDK inject grpc-trace-bin as metadata header in addition to traceparent? Also bump sampling to AlwaysOn on inference-worker so we can validate behavior end-to-end during rollback.

Diego L: I can patch the SDK wrapper to always set grpc-trace-bin and set sampler=AlwaysOn. Will roll a canary in ~10m.

Alice M: assigning actions: Raj - update envoy allowlist and coordinate rollback; Diego - deploy SDK patch canary + set sampling; Nadia - monitor collector error rate and traces ingest; I'll open incident ticket and document timeline.

Raj P: PR: https://git.redwood/ops/envoy-config/pull/512 — includes trace headers fix and test.

Diego L: Canary deployed. Early traces show child spans returning for trace 0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c. Monitoring for 15m. :thumbsup:

Alice M: great. Follow-up: add e2e test that sends a trace through API gateway + envoy + collector and asserts traceparent/tracestate survive. Also add a check in release pipeline to prevent header-mask changes without an explicit trace header test.

sre-bot: Incident created: TICKET-2026-314

Alice M: closing loop — will post postmortem draft later today and link to ticket. Thanks all.
